allowedActions.description: Compare the open directions in a local study, without committing to one of them.
Build a coarse model of one roof direction: the architect's choice if there is one, otherwise the template default. Design work then continues from the modeled direction.
Ask the architect a question and wait for the answer.
Inspect the current design state and report open technical issues.
